articles.title: Polymarket bets on U.S. marketing blitz to win back trust after 4-year ban: Report
articles.snippet: The prediction market's head of U.S. operations says the business is taking steps to legitimize itself after years of legal scrutiny.

articles.title: Bitcoin peels back to $62K as Fed-wary futures traders cut risk: Is the BTC rally over?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin hovered around the $62,000 mark following a spike in oil prices, escalating hot war in Iran and traders’ move to cut risk ahead of a Federal Reserve policy statement.

articles.title: Bank of England governor denies Farage lobbying swayed CBDC policy: Report
articles.snippet: Andrew Bailey reportedly said Bank of England policy remained independent after a meeting with Nigel Farage that included discussions on cryptocurrency.

articles.title: Berachain hard fork to replace dual-token model with WBERA rewards
articles.snippet: Berachain launched the first stage of its PoL Next upgrade, which will phase out the BGT token and shift the network's reward system to WBERA.

articles.title: Traders Sue Polymarket Over 'No' Ruling on Strategy Bitcoin Sale
articles.snippet: The plaintiffs say Polymarket added a rule after the fact, turning their winning "Yes" bet on Strategy's Bitcoin sale into a loss.
